#+TITLE: Contract fixture provenance manifest

This manifest records fixture origins and contract purposes. Synthetic cases are
authored examples; parity cases are deterministic implementation-derived oracles;
IPC fixtures are shared protocol examples imported from the coordination runtime.
These origin claims do not replace content review or the all-file redaction gate.
Any fixture seeded from an operational capture must record its source and review.

- envelopes/* :: synthetic · Class D per EC-8/11/13 + EC-1 (string "1.0" envelope version — distinct from numeric journal version by design); peers use pane_ref per redaction ruling
- scenarios/* :: synthetic · Class E full-run fixtures (spec+plan+journal+expected): gated_run_seed (E2E core-gate seed), auth_blocked_pane (wedge + attention, no duplicate send), kill9_resume (3 crash-window truncations), gate_failure_summary_feedback (bounded failure_summary on gate_failed + retry-to-green), fingerprint_drift (run_environment blocks on resume drift, policy escalate), concurrency_cap (cap=1 serialization visible in journal order). Mid-run workspace-lease release in retry/cap scenarios: legal during a nonterminal run in the shipped fold; post-terminal releases are also supported.
- parity/* :: oracle · Gate C slice-1 replay parity: 11 ScenarioHarness cases (NN_<case>.jsonl = persisted event lines, NN_<case>.summary.json = fold summary) captured using deterministic RunFSM scenarios under FixedClock base 2026-09-01T12:00:00Z and FixedId; both RunFSM and Lifecycle.Host must reproduce them byte for byte; regenerate only with an explicitly reviewed behaviour change and record the new combined digest here. Combined sha256 of `cat parity/*.jsonl parity/*.summary.json`: a28f48171e7eff57acbd5ec7f6437ccbd562e1ec7ff9f99d929ae2a73307bae2
- plans/invalid_nonpositive_timeout :: synthetic · F-4 (clock review): timeout_s must be a positive integer once deadline-load-bearing
- vocabulary note (Wave 1, NS-40) :: journals/reject_context_revision_skip, reject_agent_ratified_contract_change, reject_auto_accepted_oracle_change, fold_budget_exhausted, reject_event_id_repeat, valid_minimal, reject_seq_gap, reject_second_terminal_run, and assignment_failed-bearing fixtures contain RESERVED types on purpose: reserved means not appendable by current production code, never fold-illegal history (docs/contracts/event-vocabulary.org)
- journals/valid_requested_by :: synthetic · ADR-0001 (Wave 1, NS-09): start + cancel commands carry data.requested_by {class,id,command_id,verb,args_hash} (operator variant of the per-class union); args/seq_0001.json and args/seq_0005.json are the argument documents whose ARGS-CANON-1 (length-prefixed) bytes the test hashes to reproduce both args_hash values; derived events carry none; envelope actor stays run_supervisor; run_cancel_requested data mirrors the runtime builder (run_cancel_data) plus requested_by; the optional run_lock_path field is omitted from these fixtures; live writer ownership is enforced separately by Journal.Ownership and Journal.RunLock
- ipc/v1/* :: shared protocol examples imported from the coordination runtime (CONTRACT_HASH f1cacf8b… pinned in test/contracts/ipc_contract_hash_test.exs) · daemon reply shapes for ping, pane_status (4), send (10); dynamic fields use <name> placeholders so no literal pane ids or paths appear; authoritative contract text is docs/contracts/ipc-v1.md (EC-6)
- journals/valid_envelope_version_2_minimal :: synthetic · OPEN-01(a) envelope version 2 baseline; two events pin =prev_line_sha256= to exact prior persisted line bytes including newline

- journals/reject_missing_chain_on_version_2 :: synthetic · envelope version 2 requires =prev_line_sha256= on every event
- journals/reject_invalid_prev_line_sha256 :: synthetic · envelope version 2 rejects malformed chain digests with a named clause

- journals/reject_data_required_fields/spec.json :: synthetic · Gate B negative fixture names one required-field removal and expected rejection for each of the 33 appendable event payloads; tests apply each mutation to an immutable positive journal event
- journals/fold_recovery_reserved :: synthetic · U1a-R (docs/contracts/recovery-reservation.org) reservation vocabulary: start, attention block, run_recovery_reserved attempt 1 (executor, writer_timeout, lost_generation 1), resume resolving the attention, attempt 2 (host, owner_down, lost_generation 7), then an assignment; expected fold in_flight / last_seq 9 with recovery_reservations 2; RESERVED type on purpose (no producer); placeholder hashes, no operator data
